scope: Three reviewed source files; no taint analysis, runtime hook or full-app privacy assertion.

sites.purpose: Opening msgstore failed after read-write and read-only attempts; keep failure category without database path.
Message key lookup failed; keep category without message key.
Media path lookup failed; keep category without returned path or row identifier.
Account directory resolution failed; keep category without account or path.

sites.expression: "$TAG Failed to instantiate native dialog builder: ${t.javaClass.simpleName}"
sites.purpose: Native builder creation failed; preserve fallback diagnostic.
Native title assignment failed; exclude title.
Native message assignment failed; exclude dialog message.
Native view assignment failed; exclude view contents.
Native positive-button assignment failed; exclude button text and listener.
Native negative-button assignment failed; exclude button text and listener.
Native dialog display failed; retain fallback event.
Native dialog discovery/initialization failed; retain category only.
Status-list field discovery failed; preserve stage and exception class.
Current-status-index field discovery failed; preserve stage and exception class.
Menu-refresh hook setup failed; preserve stage and exception class.
Fragment seen-icon hook setup failed; preserve stage and exception class.
Activity seen-icon hook setup failed; preserve stage and exception class.

sites.expression: TAG + " Error handling status menu hook: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Status menu callback failed; preserve event and exception class.
Status menu method registration failed; preserve event and exception class.

sites.expression: TAG + " Error setting up status playback hook: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Outer playback setup failed; preserve event and exception class without Throwable stack/message.
Asynchronous status download failed; keep category without media path or content.

sites.expression: TAG + " DexKit activity search failed: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: DexKit status activity search failed; keep category only.

sites.expression: TAG + " StatusPlaybackActivity not found — icon placement unavailable"
sites.purpose: Status activity unavailable; a fixed literal explains missing icon placement without runtime payload.

sites.expression: TAG + " Could not hook status icon activity: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Status activity icon hook failed; keep category only.

sites.expression: TAG + " Could not attach OnPageChangeListener: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Page-change listener attachment failed; keep category only.

sites.expression: TAG + " Error resolving current status item: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Current status item resolution failed; exclude status identity/content.

sites.expression: TAG + " Error resolving current status index: " + t.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Current status index resolution failed; exclude runtime values.
Status export failed; exclude source and destination paths; localized UI separately reports category.

sites.expression: TAG + " status identity save failed: " + failure.getClass().getSimpleName()
sites.purpose: Saved-identity persistence failed; exclude stored identity set.
